stations.title: Idris
stations.say: Why is the log so big?

stations.title: store.log
stations.text: Every old count, replayed on each open.

stations.title: Your compaction
stations.gap: No way to forget old counts

captions: Idris asks why the log is so big after a month of card orders.
Every old count is still in it, and each open replays them all.
You write the log again beside the old one and swap it in at one stroke.
The log is short again, and a stop at any moment leaves one whole log.
The store forgets old counts and keeps every new one.
